what: FINDING_1 [risk-integration]: CI enforcement assumption is wrong if lint-foreground is only composed into Makefile lint
scenario_or_breakage: CI runs make lint-only for pre-commit and make test-harnesses-N for harness shards; it does not run local make lint, so the new foreground linter can pass locally but never gate PRs
suggested_fix: Add lint-foreground as a pre-commit hook, or add test-lint-foreground-markers plus lint-foreground to a test-harnesses-N shard, and update the plan's CI claim accordingly

what: FINDING_2 [correctness]: leading-command detection will miss planned Family B calls wrapped in command substitution
scenario_or_breakage: The plan explicitly targets dispatch-with-waterfall.sh and dispatch-plan-voters.sh, but current call sites start as _plan_review_dispatch=$(...) and _plan_voter_dispatch=$(...), so a leading-command scanner can fail to flag the very sites the plan says it will mark
suggested_fix: Revise the detection contract to recognize denylisted basenames anywhere in executable shell syntax inside fences, including assignments, command substitutions, if/while tests, env prefixes, bash script.sh wrappers, and quoted ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} paths; add fixture cases for those shapes

what: FINDING_3 [architecture]: marker-only lint does not enforce foreground behavior
scenario_or_breakage: A future edit can add the canonical banner and inline comment while still using run_in_background: true in the surrounding Bash tool metadata or appending & inside the shell block; the linter would be green while the blocking-script invariant is still violated
suggested_fix: Add negative checks that reject run_in_background: true in the associated paragraph/window for denylisted invocations and reject shell backgrounding of the denylisted command; add fixtures for contradictory banner-plus-background cases

what: FINDING_4 [code-quality]: linting documentation is omitted even though a new lint surface and Makefile target are planned
scenario_or_breakage: docs/linting.md is the repo's canonical linter/CI target reference, so contributors will not see what lint-foreground covers or whether it runs in CI/local lint
suggested_fix: Update docs/linting.md with the new foreground-marker linter, its Makefile target, harness target, and CI wiring once the wiring decision is fixed
